name: Alexandre Landry
bio: Alexandre Landry (born December 20, 1985) is a Québec film, television and stage actor. He is best known for his role in the 2013 film Gabrielle, for which he garnered a Canadian Screen Award nomination as Best Supporting Actor at the 2nd Canadian Screen Awards.

credits.overview: In the icy waters of Labrador, in Canada's Arctic north, a cargo ship races to deliver the last supply run of the season to the region's isolated communities – until the murder of a crew member shatters the fragile balance of the voyage.
